name: TruncateNumberNode
label: Truncate Number
description: Gets the integral or fractional digits of a numeric value, or rounds up/down the value to a specified number of decimal places.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: NumberToTruncate
fields.label: Number to Truncate
fields.description: The numeric value to truncate or round.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: Specifies how to truncate or round the number.

selectOptions.label: Get Integer Part
selectOptions.description: Retrieves only the integer portion of the number.

selectOptions.label: Get Fractional Part
selectOptions.description: Retrieves only the fractional portion of the number.

selectOptions.label: Round
selectOptions.description: Rounds the number specified number of decimal places.

fields.name: DecimalPlaces
fields.label: Decimal Places
fields.description: The number of decimal places to round to. Only applicable for rounding operations.

fields.name: RoundOperation
fields.label: Round Operation
fields.description: Specifies round up or round down the number.

selectOptions.label: Round Up
selectOptions.description: Rounds the number up to the specified number of decimal places.

selectOptions.label: Round Down
selectOptions.description: Rounds the number down to the specified number of decimal places.

fields.name: TruncatedValue
fields.label: Truncated Value
fields.description: Returns the truncated or rounded numeric value.
